summary: Planned pedestrian lane that the Design Controls connect to Mission Rock Square and, across Terry A Francois Boulevard, to Channel Wharf; protected, shaded and not accessible by vehicle. No source read reports the lane built. The Port's June 2026 Phase 2 report does not name Channel Lane or say which phase delivers it; the Commission approved up to $10 million of Phase 2 pre-development funding on June 9, 2026 (minutes).

milestones.text: Final Design Controls (document dated April 24, 2018) defines Channel Lane as a dedicated open space (Section 3.4)

facts.value: A plaza of 50 ft maximum width with a 12 ft minimum pedestrian throughway; 'protected, shaded, and not accessible by vehicle'

sources.title: Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24, 2018 (final; Section 3 open spaces, Figure 3.1.1)

Informational presentation on updates to the Mission Rock Development Project, including efforts to accelerate Phase 2, with possible action on a Port Capital investment of $10 million (Port Commission Item 11A, Resolution 26-34)
Minutes of the Port Commission Meeting, June 9, 2026 (Item 11A: Resolution 26-34 passed unanimously)

open_questions: No construction start or completion date is stated in any source read.
